title: DC-area forecast: Scattered afternoon storms, some strong
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: A quickly passing shower or storm is possible before scattered showers and storms are likely midafternoon into evening. Highs reach for the mid- to upper 80s with rising humidity.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: A quickly passing shower or storm is possible before scattered showers and storms become likely midafternoon into evening. Highs reach for the mid- to upper 80s with rising humidity.

What’s next? Friday has a shot to be mostly dry, but Saturday could feature persistent and widespread rain chances. Mostly 80s for highs into next week.

Today’s daily digit — 6/10: Temperatures are a little lower than yesterday but it's a good deal more humid and there's a storm threat. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Thursday): Partly sunny to mostly cloudy with an isolated shower or storm possible through early afternoon, then scattered showers and storms are likely especially after 2 or 3 p.m. Some could be strong, with potential for damaging wind gusts and an isolated tornado. Mid- to upper 80s should do it for highs most spots, but dew points back into the upper 60s or near 70 make it feel 5 to 8 degrees hotter. Winds are variable in direction around 10 mph. Confidence: Medium-High

Tonight: Scattered showers and strong storms remain possible through about 8 p.m. Partly cloudy overnight, with humidity still hanging around, as lows range from the mid-60s to around 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Friday): Mostly to partly sunny, and likely dry during the day, although can’t rule out an afternoon shower mainly south of DC. Highs about low to mid-80s, but humidity remains on the higher side with dew points deep into the 60s. Confidence: Medium-High

Tomorrow night: Turning cloudier over time, and showers may develop, especially after midnight. Mid-60s to low 70s for lows. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Temperatures remain close to or a bit below normal through the weekend. There's a chance of showers and storms both days, but particularly Saturday when there could be some heavier rain in a more widespread fashion. Highs mostly reach the low to mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

Humidity may fall further toward Monday, opening up the work week on a relatively nice note as sun rules and highs reach for the mid-80s. More low to mid-80 are a good bet into Tuesday and seemingly beyond. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for August 20

A torrential 1963 downpour set a rainfall record, triggering significant flooding, closing National Airport, and inundating homes and businesses across the region.
